01634750555This was probably the nicest hotel we stayed at in Vietnam. The rooms were spacious and everything was in good clean condition with comfortable beds and pillows. It's not imposing from the outside but don't let that put you off. They welcome you with roses and a drink (there's a vase in the room for the roses) and there was a kettle in the rooms for boiling water. Two free internet stations were available downstairs. The breakfast was probably the best in Vietnam too. A wide range of hot and cold options both Western and Eastern, plenty of fresh fruit and lots of interesting Vietnamese things to try. It's about 15 minutes walk to the river and "touristy area", but there are places nearby which do food. On the corner a couple of blocks towards the toursity area (turn right) there's a large restaurant with green plastic tablecloths which looks a bit unprepossessing but was full of Vietnamese. I had one the best seafood fried noodles ever in there for next to nothing. The place next door seems to act as unofficial restaurant, tour guide and laundry service for the hotel. The laundry was cheap and fast. The staff is very friendly esp Mr Le Gap the Deputy General Director, he speak english very fluently. He always ready to help you ! I will certainly come back this hotel soon !
